requirement: Keep running counts of normalized tags, ignore blank tags, subtract retracted tags and forget any that reach zero or below, and list the most frequent tags with ties ordered alphabetically.
skeleton: _normalize helper and TagTally wrapping a Counter with add, retract using subtract and unary plus, count, top sorting by negative count then name, and __len__.
caption: Tag statistics on top of the standard-library collections.Counter. A private _normalize helper strips and lower-cases each tag and drops blank ones. TagTally keeps a Counter; add(tags) updates it with the normalized tags, and retract(tags) calls subtract with the normalized tags and then replaces the counter with its unary plus, which throws away every tag whose count is zero or negative, so retracting more than was added never leaves a ghost entry. count(tag) normalizes the tag before looking it up. top(n) raises ValueError saying n must not be negative for a negative n and otherwise sorts the items by descending count and then by name, returning the first n pairs, so equal counts come out alphabetically rather than in insertion order as most_common would give. __len__ reports how many distinct tags are currently counted. The fixture asserts that Python and a padded python count as two under PYTHON while a blank tag is ignored and two tags are tracked, that three tags tied at two come out as alpha, mid and zeta, that retracting b twice and a once leaves only a with one, that top of zero is empty, and that top of minus one raises ValueError.

constraints: Tags are stripped and lower-cased and blank tags are ignored
Tags whose count drops to zero or below are forgotten
Ranking orders by count descending and then alphabetically
A negative n raises ValueError and zero returns an empty list

rationale.teaches: Counter.update and subtract, unary plus to drop non-positive counts, and an explicit sort key instead of most_common for deterministic ties.
rationale.why: Counter keeps zero and negative entries after subtract and most_common orders ties by insertion, so tallies drift from what a reader expects unless those two edges are handled.

ops.docstring: Tally tags with Counter: merge batches, forget exhausted tags, rank ties stably.

candidates.why_wrong: Blank tags are counted as an empty-string tag.
Tags retracted to zero or below stay in the counter and show up in rankings and the length.
most_common orders ties by insertion instead of alphabetically.
top rejects zero as well as negative values.
The sort key ranks the least frequent tags first.
